entities.name: Democracy
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: System of government originating in Athens (c. 508 BCE) where citizens participate directly in decision-making. Athenian democracy inspired the Roman Republic, Enlightenment political theory, and modern democratic governance worldwide.
